protocol_name: Defined Approaches on Skin Sensitisation (2o3 DA & ITSv1/v2)

endpoint.name: Skin Sensitisation
endpoint.historical_animal_test: Local Lymph Node Assay (LLNA - OECD TG 429) / Guinea Pig Maximisation Test (GPMT)

context_of_use: Rules-based combination of in chemico (DPRA) and in vitro assays (KeratinoSens, h-CLAT) with in silico tools to discriminate skin sensitisers from non-sensitisers and determine UN GHS sub-categorisation.
